keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.title: Interface
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.tv_desc: Controls when the TV version card and link appear on the home screen: never, always, or only on older devices (detects outdated browsers and automatically offers them the lightweight version).
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.standalone_d: Shows or hides the card and link to solo mode (standalone.html) on the home screen.
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.animar_fondo: Turns the background gradient and leaf motion on or off across every screen. When disabled, the background stays static.
keys.manual_admin.tools.interfaz.personalizat: Shows an event branding badge (e.g. a sponsor's logo) on every screen of the game. Lets you upload, pick and delete the logo directly from this panel.
